fieldValues.title: Two records can carry the same key and nothing notices
fieldValues.statement: When I hold reference data as records (64 hexagrams, each with its number), nothing in SRS lets me say a field is a key for its type. Two records with the same number both validate, so a data error stays in the repository until someone happens to see it. A type's identity field only chooses the record's heading.
source_ref: greenmans_creation:workspace/_meta/datasets/hexagrams.json.md (Displacement and Skinning both numbered 49; Displacement is 43)
